svg.title: Hyperbole / הפלגה
svg.desc: Chapter 6, Hebrew p75, English p76. The existing violet Figurative speech bubble contains a small ripple that swells into an oversized wave. The enlargement represents exaggeration in expression, not increasing certainty, a sound-volume control, growth over time, or a verdict that the statement is false. Ramchal names hyperbole alongside figurative usage and says to assess the intended allusion rather than the literal words. He gives a metaphor example, not a separate hyperbole example, in this passage. The generic Figurative badge can still represent nonliteral intention; this candidate distinguishes hyperbole without making it a semantic subtype of metaphor.
